entries.text: Good morning everyone, let's get started with the standup.
Morning Alice. I finished the transcript export pipeline yesterday.
Great, did the markdown converter pass the escape cases?
Yes, all forty eight smoke assertions are green now.
Perfect. What about the VTT fallback path?
Covered too, including multi-line payloads and missing voice tags.
Nice. I'll review the integration harness this afternoon.
Sounds good, ping me if the fixture server needs more routes.
Will do. Any blockers on the service worker download path?
None, the data URI path works for payloads under two megabytes.
Excellent, then the offscreen blob path only matters for large ones.
Exactly. I'll wrap up the remaining edge cases before lunch.
